AR-2026F-SR31.aiSummary: This Senate resolution recognizes Coach Van Compton for her 51-year coaching career and her impact on women’s volleyball and athletics in Arkansas. AR-2026F-SB55.aiSummary: The act sets spending for the Arkansas Supreme Court and the Supreme Court Bar of Arkansas for fiscal year 2026-2027. It funds salaries, extra help, and operating costs, including $7,666,202 for court operations and $5,733,581 for the Bar of Arkansas. It also sets the maximum number of staff for each office and takes effect on July 1, 2026.

AR-2026F-HB1066.aiSummary: This bill would set the 2026-2027 budget for the Department of Energy and Environment’s Division of Environmental Quality. It sets pay and spending limits for shared services, state operations, federal operations, and the wastewater licensing program, including a $16,834,853 federal operations amount and a $320,927 wastewater licensing amount. It also sets staff limits for the division, including up to 347 regular employees and 70 temporary or part-time workers.
